sloka: कन्क पत्र परिच्छन्ना महेन्द्र अशनि सन्निभाः ।सुपर्वाणः सुतीक्ष्ण अग्रा सरोषा भुजगा इव ॥४-८-२३॥
transliteration: kanka patra paricchannā mahendra aśani sannibhāḥ ।suparvāṇaḥ sutīkṣṇa agrā saroṣā bhujagā iva ॥4-8-23॥

translations.english: 'Here are my highspeed, winged arrows glowing like fierce fire, born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds.They are smooth and welljointed, decked with gold, comparable in strength to great Indra's thunderbolt, very sharp with pointed tips looking like angry serpents.
translations.hindi: तब मैने सु्रीब ! सुम्रोज्र ! कह कर, वार बार पुकारा | किन्तु जब मुझे किसी ने उत्तर न दिया; तव मुझे बड़ा दुःख हुआ .
